# Dr Arut — Website Context

## About the Business

This is the personal/professional website of **Dr Arut** (Dr Arutchelvam Vijayaraman), a UK-based Consultant Physician in Endocrinology, Diabetes, Obesity & Metabolism with more than 40 years in medicine and nearly two decades as a consultant. The site is a straightforward introduction to his work and perspective, with a growing focus on the emerging science of longevity and wellness. His work sits where hormones, metabolism and modern medical technology meet — and increasingly turns to the larger question of how people can stay genuinely well, for longer. **FRCP (London) · GMC Reg. 5195245.**

## Location & Contact

- **Based:** United Kingdom
- **Affiliations:** The James Cook University Hospital, Middlesbrough; South East Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust
- **Email:** contact@drarut.co.uk
- **Primary channel:** On-site enquiry form (name, email, phone, country, area of interest, message); enquiries handled confidentially and without obligation

## Current Focus

*Beyond treating illness — a deeper interest in how we live well, for longer.* Much of Dr Arut's career has centred on weight, diabetes and metabolic health; he helped build obesity services regionally and nationally and shaped how a generation of physicians is trained to treat the condition without judgement. His attention has turned increasingly to longevity — including the emerging study of peptides and polypeptides for longevity. He is candid that injectable polypeptide approaches being explored in clinical trials and laboratories are not FDA-approved treatments but investigational methods still being tested, and he follows the work with evidence-led caution.

## Clinical Expertise (services / highlights)

- **Endocrinology & Hormonal Health** — thyroid, pituitary, adrenal and gonadal disorders
- **Obesity & Weight Medicine** — modern, non-judgemental weight management (national-curriculum-level expertise)
- **Diabetes & Technology** — type 1 and type 2 diabetes, insulin pumps and hybrid closed-loop systems, interest in type 2 remission
- **Bone Health & Osteoporosis** — bone density and fracture-risk assessment and management
- **Lipid & Metabolic Conditions** — advanced lipid management (incl. inclisiran and PCSK9-inhibitor therapy) and complex metabolic conditions
- **Longevity & Wellness** — an evidence-led interest in living well for longer

## Selected Clinical Work

- **Weight & Metabolic Medicine** — leading service development regionally and nationally since 2009; helped author the UK training curriculum in obesity; non-judgemental approach focused on health, confidence and quality of life.
- **Diabetes Care & Technology** — leads an NHS insulin-pump service caring for 1,000+ patients on hybrid closed-loop systems; particular interest in reversal/remission of type 2 diabetes.

## Credentials & Recognition

- **Qualifications:** MD; MRCP (RCP London); FRCP (RCP London); CCT (UK) — Endocrinology; MSc — Health Care Leadership, NHS UK; PGDME — Newcastle University, UK; GMC Reg. 5195245
- **Appointments & Leadership:** Consultant Physician — Endocrinology, Diabetes, Obesity & Metabolism; The James Cook University Hospital, Middlesbrough; South East Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust; Clinical Lead for Obesity — North East & Northumbria ICB; Contributor — UK National Obesity Curriculum (GMC / JRCPTB); published in peer-reviewed journals
- **Trust markers:** 40+ years in medicine; ~20 years as a consultant; leading obesity care since 2009

## Understanding Longevity (editorial section)

The site distinguishes lifespan (how long we live) from healthspan (how long we live well), framing longevity as closing the gap between the two. It stresses that health is built long before it is lost, that medicine is shifting attention upstream toward prevention, and that longevity science — including peptide science — must be read with evidence-led care, curiosity tempered by caution.
